title: July 28 Town Expansion Frozen Scope, Evidence and Publication Register

scopeFreeze.instruction: Consolidate every owner request from the thread, including the latest Worker Town adult theater, dedicated modern non-T2B owner tunnel, extravagant stairs and lifts, future mini-city reservation and sales office, corrected 24-slot data-campus register, preserved campus-road holdout home, planned Iowa Data District Phase 0 and complete Concord service town, without deploying the world, Sites or Box.
scopeFreeze.ownerIntent: Complete the full program autonomously, document it exhaustively, and do not treat an offline model as a live result.
scopeFreeze.adultProgramBoundary: Tasteful, private, consensual-adult, non-graphic architecture and programming only. No explicit imagery or graphic sexual content.
prohibitedClaims: No town-expansion physical work may be described as live, committed, verified or accepted without a transaction ledger and independent post-state QA.
No new screenshot may be described as an after image unless it is captured from an accepted immutable post-state and matched to its object and camera.
No town-expansion database object may be described as imported without an accepted import ledger and integrity check.
No town-expansion Sites content may be described as published without a saved version, production deployment and health check.
No July 28 Box handoff may be described as complete without remote path, size and hash verification.

definitions.REQUESTED: Owner requirement is recorded; no spatial or implementation claim is implied.
definitions.SURVEYED: Existing conditions or a candidate site were measured from a named immutable or point-in-time source.
definitions.RESEARCHED: Standards, precedents or program references were reviewed and converted into a written design basis.
definitions.DESIGNED: A coordinated program, envelope, route or acceptance contract exists.
definitions.GENERATED_OFFLINE: Exact-state operation and rollback artifacts or rendered media exist locally; this is not live completion.
definitions.PREFLIGHTED: Fresh source identity, exact guards, collision checks, protected-state checks and parser contracts pass.
definitions.COMMITTED_LIVE: An atomic transaction ledger records successful live execution.
definitions.VERIFIED_POST_STATE: Independent immutable post-state, movement, geometry and matched-media gates pass.
definitions.IMPORTED_DATABASE: Accepted objects and relations were imported with an integrity-checked ledger.
definitions.PUBLISHED_SITES: A source-pinned Sites version is saved, deployed and healthy.
definitions.BOX_VERIFIED: Every required remote object has a verified path, byte count and SHA-256.

compoundStates.MODELED_BLOCKED: Designed/generated offline but blocked from preflight or live release.
compoundStates.PROVISIONAL_SURVEY: Read-only measurements exist but the candidate geometry is still being refined.
compoundStates.PENDING_CLOSEOUT: Required final evidence or publication has not yet been produced.
compoundStates.ACCEPTED_PREDECESSOR: A prior, separately controlled release is accepted and immutable; it does not prove the new expansion.

masterPlanOutline.name: Ravensreach Civic Garth and Town Fabric
masterPlanOutline.designIntent: A legible period civic ensemble organized around longhouse court, enlarged library, pavilion and monumental Guild Hall, with complete block edges, purposeful thresholds and a finished penthouse skyline.
masterPlanOutline.nextControlPoint: Resolve protected chest and independent overlap/access/hydrology findings, then regenerate against a fresh immutable baseline.

masterPlanOutline.name: Town-to-Stadium Ceremonial Parkway and Oasis
masterPlanOutline.designIntent: An unmistakable, walkable destination corridor with a wider ceremonial road, progressive billboards, real stadium screens and a halfway tollway-style oasis above an original game-inspired mini-bunker.
masterPlanOutline.nextControlPoint: Complete sightline, road-grade, screen, wayfinding, bunker-egress and matched-camera contracts.

masterPlanOutline.name: Westlight Island, Piers and Crater Waterfront
masterPlanOutline.designIntent: A coherent stadium-island entertainment district whose pier buildings, amusement structures, restaurants, malls, crater lake, quay and green space share aligned pedestrian axes.
masterPlanOutline.nextControlPoint: Close venue sightlines, shoreline containment, circulation and package-interface gates.

masterPlanOutline.name: Westward Parks, Lakeside Housing and Workforce Link
masterPlanOutline.designIntent: Paired original dry and water parks with a westward greenbelt road, Hampton-influenced medium-density lakeside housing, two dignified workforce projects, shared outdoor space and a direct staff route.
masterPlanOutline.nextControlPoint: Prove hydrology, dry-park and water-park completeness, continuous public waterfront, housing access and staff-route walkability.

masterPlanOutline.name: MainStreet America Surface, Guest Services and Subsurface Logistics
masterPlanOutline.designIntent: A compact, comprehensible two-street development with complete roads, all-attached garages, appropriately brought-in service buildings, a full Guest Services/rooftop-wellness program and an underground logistics/RV district.
masterPlanOutline.nextControlPoint: Rebase B01 on the same-moment employee-lounge/greenway state, resolve rooftop structural hold and prove every garage is physically attached and usable.

masterPlanOutline.name: C01 Hidden Bunker and Recovered P01
masterPlanOutline.designIntent: Move the entire bunker complex east, restore the complete parking field, create a terrain-following side-mountain road, recess the portal and conceal all structural shell with natural cover while preserving full program and independent egress.
masterPlanOutline.nextControlPoint: Reconcile the competing coordinate schedules, prove access-road geometry and cover, define data migration and complete an independent no-shell-visible camera set.

masterPlanOutline.name: Northeast Data and Aviation Megacampus
masterPlanOutline.designIntent: A status-controlled 24-slot DSM campus register, separately verified functional hall program, NOC/power/dormitory/aviation/logistics functions, independent presentation and cinema venues, a distinct InfoBunker annex, a preserved holdout home, and three planned/unbuilt Iowa Phase 0 precincts reached by future roads.
masterPlanOutline.nextControlPoint: Publish the 24-slot built/approved/planned inventory, preserve the holdout parcel, close hydrology/warehouse/rack/circulation findings, and keep all Phase 0 halls visibly planned and empty.

masterPlanOutline.name: Observatory Owner Estate and Inactive Portal Gallery
masterPlanOutline.designIntent: An over-the-top owner estate around the observatory with secure shelter, owner wellness and private non-graphic rooms, monumental circulation and a completely inactive portal gallery.
masterPlanOutline.nextControlPoint: Resolve geometry/NBT conflicts and prove zero active portal blocks plus safe accessible movement.

masterPlanOutline.name: Worker Town Steward Quarter and Adult Theater
masterPlanOutline.designIntent: Upgrade the steward quarter with mini-mansions and a separate, architecturally rich adult cabaret/theater that remains non-graphic, age-controlled, acoustically isolated, accessible and operationally complete.
masterPlanOutline.nextControlPoint: Protect the two out-of-target beds and blocked mini-mansion chest, integrate the clean theater/descent plan into a fresh generator package, then pass stage/sightline, egress, acoustic, service, stair/lift and camera gates.

masterPlanOutline.name: Dedicated Modern Owner Tunnel and Future Mini-City
masterPlanOutline.designIntent: A new owner-only modern subterranean spine that is explicitly not the Raven Rock T2b system, with high-finish rest nodes, extravagant stairs and lifts, a protected future mini-city reservation and a development sales/reservations office.
masterPlanOutline.nextControlPoint: Integrate the dry alignment, seven rest nodes, two grand stair/lift halls, reservation and sales office into a fresh exact-guarded package while preserving the one intentional mansion interface and every network exclusion.

masterPlanOutline.name: World Catalog, Media, Dossier, Sites and Box
masterPlanOutline.designIntent: Make every accepted object reviewable through a full-world atlas, detailed district maps, floor plans, matched screenshots, database census/crosswalk, PM dossier, production Sites browser and durable verified Box archive.
masterPlanOutline.nextControlPoint: Wait for an accepted post-state, then regenerate catalog/atlas/media/PDF, save and deploy a pinned Sites version, upload the identical manifest set to Box and remotely verify every hash.

masterPlanOutline.name: Concord Data-District Service Town
masterPlanOutline.designIntent: A fully built compact two-street town along the data road, with ordinary gas/post/bar frontage and a deliberate non-graphic adult-nightlife economy behind it: 25-room motel, 72-seat theater annex, separate dance venue, shared night court, worker shuttle/lounge/late food, service routes and future entertainment frontage.
masterPlanOutline.nextControlPoint: Select a conflict-free terraced parcel, freeze coordinates, integrate the complete town into final exact operations, and independently verify exact room/seat counts, route isolation, terrain, parking, utilities and future parcels.

requiredContentRules: Every page shows evidence state and release ID.
Requested, designed, modeled and accepted objects use visibly different badges.
Only accepted post-state media appears in before/after sliders.
Object pages use exact database/media relations; no filename-only inference.
Adult-program pages use non-graphic text and imagery.
All downloadable files include size and SHA-256.
Production deploy may occur only from a saved version pinned to the exact pushed source commit.
prePublishChecks: No broken internal routes or asset links.
PDF opens and page count is nonzero.
Production health check returns HTTP 200 and Worker outcome ok.

requiredEntrySchema.remoteSha256: 64 lowercase hex characters or connector-verified content hash with algorithm

releaseGates.gate: Freeze final requirements, object IDs, package interfaces and one authoritative coordinate basis.
Regenerate from a fresh same-moment immutable snapshot and capture source hash.
Achieve zero missing cells, zero unauthorized protected block-entity targets, zero unreviewed cross-scope overrides and exact rollback bijection.
Close independent geometry, hydrology, cover, capacity, sightline, access, stair, lift, egress and no-intersection findings.
Run strict source-state preflight and forward/rollback parser dry runs.
Clear entities/players and execute one coordinated atomic transaction with compensation rules.
Freeze immutable post snapshot and independently verify exact target/rollback states.
Run all required bidirectional normal-walk, stair, lift/accessibility, driving and sightline tests.
Capture prescribed matched after media and generate the full atlas.
Import accepted objects/relations into the database with integrity ledger, then regenerate exact world catalog.
Compile and verify final all-session PM HTML/PDF.
Prepare, commit, save, deploy and health-check the new Sites version.
Upload the identical final manifest set to Box and verify every remote path, byte count and hash.

openDecisionsAndRisks.resolution: Trace each finding to a final-source closure test; do not dismiss it because WIP coverage flags are true.

openDecisionsAndRisks.issue: The clean selected owner-tunnel/theater/city/ascent plan still contains gravity cells and one intentional 276-cell mansion interface, and it is absent from the current WIP operations.
openDecisionsAndRisks.resolution: Pre-support gravity cells top-down, reconcile the interface in one scope, regenerate from a same-moment source and repeat zero-fluid/zero-BE/no-network-intersection tests.

openDecisionsAndRisks.issue: B01 rooftop pool lacks a proven interior structural load path.
openDecisionsAndRisks.resolution: Independent support redesign and containment proof before modeling.

openDecisionsAndRisks.issue: B01 review and WIP coverage disagree on employee lounge/greenway presence.
openDecisionsAndRisks.resolution: Use one same-moment immutable source and reconcile object/state lineage.
Issue one controlled relocation schedule and supersession record before generation.

openDecisionsAndRisks.issue: Large active-water programs can escape containment or invalidate adjacent states.
openDecisionsAndRisks.resolution: Staged barriers, exact water sources, neighbor-fluid census and immutable post-flow QA.

openDecisionsAndRisks.issue: 145 scopes and more than 2.3 million targets make cross-scope overrides and atomic recovery material risks.
openDecisionsAndRisks.resolution: Independent overlap/override ownership, transaction chunking with fixed order, full compensation feasibility and exact ledger.

openDecisionsAndRisks.issue: A screen object can exist while a seating bank still faces a doorway, blank wall or obstruction.
openDecisionsAndRisks.resolution: Seat-level ray/sightline matrix and prescribed view cameras for every venue.

openDecisionsAndRisks.issue: Named precedents could be interpreted as copy instructions.
openDecisionsAndRisks.resolution: Use them only for planning principles, mood and program; keep geometry, assets and identity original.

openDecisionsAndRisks.issue: Interim Sites and Box evidence could be mistaken for final closeout.
openDecisionsAndRisks.resolution: Keep predecessor and town-expansion publication states visibly separate; require saved version/deploy and remote Box hash ledger.

openDecisionsAndRisks.issue: Adult-program requirements could drift into graphic content or inadequate privacy/safety.
